data.name: Raed
data.gender_notes: Raed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who reads or sees the truth, a scholar or a wise person. The name Raed carries the meaning “Reader, Seer, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raed usually hope their child will grow to embody reader, seer, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek knowledge and wisdom, and use their insight to guide others
data.etymology: Raed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reader, Seer, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raed total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رائد
in_arabic.meaning: رائد - من يأتي بالشيء قبل غيره، يقود الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: رائد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: من يأتي بالشيء قبل غيره، يقود الناس، المبتكر، الرائد. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفتح الآية 6 ﴿وَمُؤَمِّنًا لِكُلِّ أَمْرٍ مِّن أَمُورِ الدُّنْيَا وَالدِّينِ﴾ حيث وصفت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم بـ 'رائد' لكونه يقود الناس في معراجهم الديني و الدنيوي.

in_urdu.name: رائد
in_urdu.meaning: رائد - وہ شخص جو کسی کام کو سب سے پہلے کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رائد کا نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی کام کو سب سے پہلے کرتا ہے، رہنما، قائد. اسلامی تقویم میں رائد ایک قابل ذکر نام ہے کیونکہ یہ ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو دوسروں سے ممتاز کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रायेद
in_hindi.meaning: रायेद - जो सबसे पहले कुछ करता है, मार्गदर्शक
in_hindi.long_meaning: रायेद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है 'जो सबसे पहले कुछ करता है' या 'मार्गदर्शक'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति को दूसरों से अलग करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: رائد
in_pashto.meaning: رائد - لومړنی کس چې کوم کار کوي، مشر
in_pashto.long_meaning: رائد نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا معنی لري لومړنی کس چې کوم کار کوي، مشر، رهبر. په اسلامي کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو ځانګړتیاوو څرګندونه کوي چې يو فرد نورو څخه جلا کوي.

in_english.name: Raed
in_english.meaning: Raed - a leader, pioneer, or someone who does something first
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raed originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'رأد' (ra'd), meaning 'leader', 'pioneer', or 'someone who does something first'. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person who guides others or initiates actions. The name has been used historically across various Muslim cultures to denote individuals with leadership qualities.

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic culture, the name Raed carries a strong association with intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. In various Muslim communities, teachers or scholars are often given this name as a sign of respect for their knowledge and understanding. It also marks a connection to the rich history and literary traditions of Islam, emphasizing the importance of eternal wisdom and learning.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raed can symbolize one's progressive journey towards truth and God-consciousness. The Arabic root 'R-A-D' carries the concept of seeing or reading the signs of God in our daily lives. Individuals with this name are encouraged to enhance their knowledge of the Quran and the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to gain deeper insights and strengthen their connection with the divine. Additionally, Raed can be seen as a reminder to live a life committed to Learning and truthfulness in all aspects, ultimately becoming true Servants to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Reader, Seer, Intelligent" symbolizes One who reads or sees the truth, a scholar or a wise person. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raed serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of reader, seer, intelligent.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, 14th century The name Raed carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun mentions Raed as a name of a Berber leader in Al-Andalus.
